chunks: But in case you are speaking the truth, then make a segment of the sky to fall upon us.
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask the Prophet to do to prove he was telling the truth?
ai.summary: This verse captures the arrogant challenge of the Quraysh poets, who demanded a tangible, catastrophic sign—such as a fragment of the sky falling—to validate Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) prophethood. In Shia exegesis, this reflects the broader theme of divine patience and the distinction between those who seek signs out of conviction versus those who demand them out of stubbornness, as seen in the subsequent verses where the sign is withheld.
